arguments.summary: The 502s on the checkout page were caused by an ingress idle timeout of 30 seconds. The intermediate certificate had expired, and manual replacement was required. Cron does not run jobs in random order. The failed jobs backlog was unblocked by removing 47 malformed rows from the failed_jobs table. Pgbouncer was restarted to ensure proper operation.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Monitor the system for any issues related to the certificate or cron and address them promptly. Continue to monitor the failed jobs backlog to ensure it remains clear.
